intro: Tadepalligudem is a market and college town in West Godavari, in the middle of the Godavari delta's paddy and coconut country. It is home to the National Institute of Technology, Andhra Pradesh, and several other colleges, and many of these campuses house staff families on site. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for such campuses, and for schools and societies in the town, at our factory in Vasai East, about 950 km away.

The delta is hot and humid, with the south-west monsoon from June to September and cyclone rain from the Bay of Bengal later in the year. Our trucks bring the equipment by road, and our installation team or a dealer in south India puts it up on site. Tell us how many families live in the quarters and the ages of their children. We will suggest a set of pieces and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

sections.h: Play areas for staff quarters on a college campus
sections.html:
Children in staff quarters are usually of mixed ages, from toddlers to early teens, and most of them come out at the same hour each evening. One compact multi play station with a low slide covers the younger ones. Add a climber or a swing set for older children so the two groups do not compete for one structure.

Place the play area within sight of the quarters and away from roads used by campus buses. Campus estate offices often want everything on one drawing for approval, so we mark each piece and its safe zone clearly. For fitness equipment for staff and students, see our outdoor gym page for Tadepalligudem.

faq.q: Can you supply playground equipment for college staff quarters?
faq.a: Yes. Share the size of the open space and the age range of the children living there. We will suggest equipment for younger and older children and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

faq.q: Will the equipment cope with humid delta weather?
faq.a: The posts are galvanised steel and the slides and panels are roto-moulded plastic, which does not rust. Keep the base well drained so water does not stand around the posts after heavy rain.

faq.q: How do you deliver to Tadepalligudem?
faq.a: We send the equipment by road from our factory in Vasai East, about 950 km away, and install it through our own installation team or a dealer in south India.

intro: Tadipatri, on the Penna river in Anantapur district, is known for its stone polishing works, and that stone often ends up paving the town's school courtyards and society compounds. Polished stone looks neat, but it is a hard and slippery surface for a child to fall on. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colonies and parks in Tadipatri at our factory in Vasai East, about 740 km away.

This is the dry, hot Rayalaseema region, with low rainfall and long summers that run well into May. The equipment travels by road, and our installation team or a dealer in south India fixes it on site, self-standing or grouted. Send us photos of the ground as it is today, paved or bare, with its length and width. We will plan the equipment and the surface together on one layout drawing.

sections.h: What to lay under the equipment on a paved site
sections.html:
A slide or swing should never sit directly on granite, stone slabs or concrete. Keep the safe play area free of hard paving and lay rubber flooring there instead, which we supply along with the equipment. Rubber flooring is usually laid over a level concrete base, so on an existing courtyard you may only need to repair the base, not break it up.

Keep a strip of paving outside the safe zone for parents and teachers to stand on. In the Rayalaseema heat, stone and dark flooring both get hot by afternoon, so plan shade or keep play to mornings and evenings. Roto-moulded parts such as a wave slide can be ordered in lighter shades. See also our Anantapur page.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a stone or concrete courtyard?
faq.a: Yes, but the area children can fall on should be covered with an impact-absorbing surface such as rubber flooring. We mark this safe play area on the layout drawing so you know exactly how much to cover.

faq.q: Do you supply rubber flooring with the equipment?
faq.a: Yes. We can supply rubber flooring for the play area along with the equipment, so the surface and the pieces are planned on the same drawing.

faq.q: Do you install in Tadipatri?
faq.a: Yes. The equipment comes by road from Vasai East, about 740 km away. Our installation team or a dealer in south India sets it up, self-standing or grouted.

intro: In Tenali, many schools start with nursery and pre-primary classes, and those small children are often the ones who use the playground most. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, play schools and residential colonies in Tenali at our factory in Vasai East, about 890 km away in Maharashtra.

Tenali lies in the Krishna delta in Guntur district, a canal-fed farming area that is hot and humid for much of the year. The town also has a long tradition in theatre and the arts. We send the equipment by road and install it through our own team or a local dealer. Tell us how many small children use the ground at a time. We will suggest low, gentle pieces and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked. The same drawing can show where equipment for the older classes should go later.

sections.h: Equipment for nursery and pre-primary children
sections.html:
Children aged 2 to 5 need low platforms, short slides and handholds within easy reach. A small station such as Tiny Tot gives them climbing and sliding at a height they can manage. Spring riders and a toddler swing with bucket seats add movement at a gentle pace.

Keep the nursery play area apart from equipment for older children, ideally behind a low fence or hedge, so bigger children do not run through it. Teachers should be able to see every piece from one spot. Lay rubber flooring under everything, because small children fall often. Bright roto-moulded colours help young children find and name each piece.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits children under five?
faq.a: Low multi play stations, short slides, spring riders and toddler swings with bucket seats. Each should have handholds at a small child's reach and an impact-absorbing surface underneath.

faq.q: Should the nursery play area be separate from the main playground?
faq.a: Yes, where space allows. A separate corner with a low fence or hedge keeps older children from running through and lets teachers watch the younger ones easily.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Tenali?
faq.a: Yes. After you approve the layout drawing and quote, we manufacture in Vasai, deliver by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.

intro: Tezpur sits on the north bank of the Brahmaputra and is home to a central university, an Air Force station and a large army presence. Much of the demand for playgrounds here comes from inside these campuses, where families live in quarters with their own parks. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for them, and for schools and town parks, at our factory in Vasai East, about 2,190 km away.

The climate is humid, with heavy rain from about May to September and mild winters. We dispatch the equipment by road to Tezpur, and our installation team or a dealer in eastern India sets it up. Share the size of the park, photos and the ages of the children. We send back a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, which you can put up for approval.

sections.h: Working inside a defence or university campus
sections.html:
Installation on a secured campus needs a little paperwork before the truck arrives. Ask your estate or works office early about vehicle entry, the names of our installers and the hours when work is allowed. We can share the list of pieces and the layout drawing in advance, which most offices need for their file.

Choose a park location with firm, raised ground, since rain in this part of Assam can go on for months. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts handle the wet season well. A merry-go-round or a multi play station suits a quarters park where many children play together in the evening. See also our Assam page.

faq.q: Can your team install equipment on a defence campus?
faq.a: Yes, once entry permission is arranged. We share the list of pieces, the layout drawing and the installers' details in advance so your office can issue passes before installation day.

faq.q: Is the equipment suited to Assam's long rainy season?
faq.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts do not rust. Install on firm, raised ground with good drainage, and use rubber flooring so the surface stays usable after rain.

faq.q: How far is your factory from Tezpur?
faq.a: About 2,190 km. We manufacture in Vasai East, Maharashtra, send the equipment by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: Many school and temple-town grounds in Thanjavur have an old neem, rain tree or banyan that gives the only shade on a hot afternoon. Putting play equipment under it seems obvious, but big trees bring their own problems. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment for schools, parks, hotels and societies in Thanjavur at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,160 km away.

Thanjavur is in the Cauvery delta, the rice-growing heart of Tamil Nadu, and is known for the Brihadeeswarar Temple and its painting tradition. It is hot for most of the year, and most of the rain comes with the north-east monsoon from October to December. We send equipment by road and install it through our own team or a dealer in south India. Send us photos that show where the trees stand, and we will place each piece on a layout drawing with its safe play area.

sections.h: Placing equipment around old shade trees
sections.html:
Keep slides, swings and climbers outside the spread of a large tree's branches, where dead wood is most likely to fall. Roots near the surface also make grouting difficult, and digging through them can harm the tree. A few metres out, the equipment still gets shade for part of the day.

Leaves and bird droppings collect on decks and slides under trees, so plan a quick sweep each morning. Have the canopy checked once a year and dead branches removed before the monsoon. Benches can go right under the tree for parents. Not far away, we installed a resort playground in Dindigul. You can also see our Tiruchirappalli page.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be placed under a tree?
faq.a: It is safer to place it just outside the tree's canopy, where falling branches are less likely to land. The equipment still gets shade for part of the day, and roots are not damaged when the posts are grouted.

faq.q: When should we install in Thanjavur?
faq.a: Most of Thanjavur's rain falls between October and December, so installing outside those months makes grouting and curing easier. Share your site details early so the layout is approved in time.

faq.q: Do you supply hotels and resorts in the Cauvery delta?
faq.a: Yes. We have done a resort playground in Dindigul, and we follow the same process for a hotel garden in Thanjavur: site photos, a layout drawing, approval, then manufacture and installation.

intro: Office campuses at Technopark and the government offices of the state capital employ many young parents, and some now run creches or day-care centres with a small outdoor play area. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these, as well as for schools, apartment projects and city parks in Thiruvananthapuram. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,290 km away.

Kerala's capital gets rain from two monsoons, the south-west from June and the north-east from October, and sites near Kovalam and Shanghumugham also get salt air. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit this weather. Our team or a dealer in south India installs the equipment once it reaches the city by road. Send the size of the outdoor space and the ages of the children in the day-care, and we will reply with a layout drawing.

sections.h: Outdoor play areas for office creches and day-care centres
sections.html:
A creche play area is usually small, fenced and used by children aged 1 to 5 in short, supervised turns. Pick low pieces such as spring riders, a short 3 ft slide and a small play station. Leave out tall towers and fast merry-go-rounds.

Facility managers usually want the space easy to clean and quick to dry after rain. Rubber flooring drains faster than grass and can be swept every day. Put the play area next to the creche door, inside the campus fence, with room for a carer's bench. For an outdoor gym for staff, see our Thiruvananthapuram outdoor gym page.

faq.q: What equipment suits a day-care play area?
faq.a: Low, slow pieces such as spring riders, a short slide, a small play station and a toddler swing. Lay rubber flooring underneath and fence the area so carers can watch every child.

faq.q: How does the equipment handle two monsoons a year?
faq.a: Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic do not rust. Give the base a drainage slope, and rinse off salt from time to time if the site is close to the coast.

faq.q: Do you supply corporate campuses in Thiruvananthapuram?
faq.a: Yes. We send a layout drawing your facility team can approve, then manufacture in Vasai, deliver by road and install with our own team or a local dealer.

intro: Thoothukudi is a port city with salt pans along its coast, and both put salt into the air that settles on anything left outdoors. Bare steel near the sea starts to rust quickly here. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, port and industrial colonies, and parks in Thoothukudi at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,310 km away.

The city is hot and fairly dry for most of the year, with most of its rain from October to December. The finished pieces reach Thoothukudi by road, and our own team or a south Indian dealer installs them. Tell us how far your site is from the sea and send a few photos. We will pick materials and a layout to suit, with the safe play area marked on the drawing.

sections.h: Choosing parts that stand up to salt
sections.html:
The more of a structure that is roto-moulded plastic, the less there is to corrode. Slides, panels and roofs in plastic are unaffected by salt. Steel posts and frames should be galvanised, and any scratch in that coating should be touched up quickly. Nuts and bolts are the parts to watch, so ask us at handover which ones to check.

Hose the equipment down with fresh water every few weeks, and again after a windy spell, to wash off salt and dust. Avoid a spot where spray or dust from the salt pans blows in directly. A wall or hedge on the sea side helps. Ask us to suggest pieces with fewer exposed steel parts. See also Tirunelveli and our Tamil Nadu and Kerala page.

faq.q: Does salt air damage playground equipment in Thoothukudi?
faq.a: Salt attacks bare steel. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded plastic parts hold up much better, and a fresh-water rinse every few weeks keeps salt from building up on the joints.

faq.q: Which parts should we check most often near the sea?
faq.a: Nuts, bolts and any place where the galvanised coating is scratched. We explain which fixings to check at handover. Springs and bearings carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

faq.q: Do you install in Thoothukudi?
faq.a: Yes. The equipment travels by road from our factory in Vasai East, about 1,310 km away, and our installation team or a dealer in south India installs it.

intro: Thrissur gets rain on most days from June to September, and in many schools the playground stands empty for much of that time. A covered play area can keep children playing through the monsoon. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, churches and temple trusts, housing projects and parks in Thrissur at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,050 km away.

Often called the cultural capital of Kerala, Thrissur has a large number of schools and a steady flow of new apartment and villa projects around the town. Each order goes to Thrissur by road and is installed by our team or a dealer in south India. Send us the size of your ground or shed, its roof height and a few photos. We will reply with a layout drawing that marks the safe play area around each piece.

sections.h: Planning a covered play area for the monsoon
sections.html:
Many Thrissur schools already have a roofed assembly area or a covered shed that can double as a play space. Measure the clear height under the roof, since the top of a play station must sit well below the beams. Leave the sides open for air so the floor dries between showers.

Self-standing equipment suits a covered area with a finished floor, because nothing has to be dug into it. Rubber flooring stops children slipping on a wet, smooth surface. Outside, a gazebo gives parents somewhere dry to wait. See also our Kochi page.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed under a roof?
faq.a: Yes, if there is enough clear height above the tallest piece. Send us the roof height and floor size, and we will suggest equipment that fits, with its safe play area marked.

faq.q: Which installation method suits a covered floor?
faq.a: Self-standing equipment can stand on a finished floor without digging. Grouting suits open ground, where posts can be set into concrete footings.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Thrissur?
faq.a: Yes. We make the equipment in Vasai East and send it about 1,050 km by road, then install it through our own team or a dealer in south India.

intro: Tea estates around Tinsukia often run their own schools and look after the welfare of families in the garden lines, and a playground is a common request. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for estate schools and colonies, as well as for town schools, oil and railway colonies and parks in Tinsukia. Everything comes from our factory in Vasai East, about 2,460 km away.

Upper Assam is one of the wettest parts of the country, with heavy rain from about April to October and cool winters. Estate sites can be a long way down unpaved roads. The equipment goes by road all the way to Upper Assam, where our own team or a dealer in eastern India installs it. Share photos of the site and of the approach road, and we will plan the delivery along with the layout drawing.

sections.h: Playgrounds for tea estate schools and lines
sections.html:
An estate often wants play areas at more than one place: the school, a creche and one or two open spaces in the lines. Planning them together on one order means one dispatch over a long distance. Match the pieces to who uses each site. Small children need spring riders and low slides near the creche, while the school ground can take a multi play station and see-saws.

Choose firm, raised spots that do not flood in the rains, and grout the posts so they stay put in soft soil. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic stand up to the damp. Ask the estate's own staff to do a simple monthly check of bolts and seats. See our Dibrugarh page too.

faq.q: Can you supply several play areas on one tea estate?
faq.a: Yes. Send us photos and sizes for each site. We plan them together on one order, with a layout drawing for each, so everything is dispatched from Vasai at once.

faq.q: Will the equipment survive Upper Assam's rain?
faq.a: Galvanised posts and roto-moulded parts do not rust. Place each play area on firm, raised ground and grout the posts so soft, wet soil does not loosen them.

faq.q: Can a truck reach an estate on an unpaved road?
faq.a: Send us photos of the approach road and the nearest point a truck can reach. We plan the delivery and installation around it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: When the bell rings for the break in a large Tiruchirappalli school, hundreds of children can reach the playground within a few minutes. The equipment has to give them all something to do without a crowd on one slide. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, colonies and parks in Trichy at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,140 km away.

Trichy is one of Tamil Nadu's main education centres, with the Rockfort at its heart and Srirangam across the Kaveri. Summers are long and hot, and most of the rain comes from October to December. We truck the equipment to Trichy and install it with our own crew or a dealer in south India. Tell us how many children use the ground at one time, and we will plan the equipment around that number on a layout drawing.

sections.h: Planning for a full school break
sections.html:
Each piece of equipment can take a set number of children at once, and we use those numbers to plan for your break time. A large station from Play Lands holds many children together, while a swing takes one per seat. Spread the crowd across several stations instead of one tall structure. Climbers, see-saws and a merry-go-round each take a group.

Leave wide paths between stations so children can move without cutting through swing zones. Stagger breaks by class if the ground is small. Shade matters in Trichy's heat, so place the busiest pieces where trees or buildings cover them before noon. Our nearest finished project is a resort playground in Dindigul.

faq.q: How many children can a school playground take at once?
faq.a: It depends on the pieces. Each station has its own capacity, so tell us how many children come out at each break and we will suggest a mix that spreads them across the ground.

faq.q: Is one big structure better than several small ones?
faq.a: For large schools, several stations usually work better. Children spread out, queues are shorter and one repair does not close the whole playground.

faq.q: Do you install in Tiruchirappalli?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai East, about 1,140 km away, and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.

intro: From June to September, strong winds blow across the plains of southern Tamil Nadu, which is why the country around Tirunelveli is dotted with wind turbines. Those winds matter when you put up a playground with roofs, panels and swings. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, colleges, colonies and parks in Tirunelveli at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,290 km away.

Tirunelveli sits on the Thamirabarani river and is known for its halwa and the Nellaiappar temple. It is hot for most of the year, with the main rain from October to December. Equipment reaches Tirunelveli by road, and installation is done by our own team or a dealer in the south. Send us photos of the site and tell us which way the wind usually comes from, and we will plan the layout with that in mind.

sections.h: Installing play equipment on a windy site
sections.html:
On open ground that takes the full force of the wind, grout the posts into concrete footings instead of using self-standing bases. Tall structures with roofs or solid panels catch the most wind, so a lower climber or a compact station may suit an exposed corner better. Keep the tallest piece behind a building or a row of trees if you can.

Do not tie cloth shade sails over the equipment without proper fixings, as the wind lifts and tears them. Fine dust also blows in during the windy months, so check swing bearings and wipe slides more often then. Bearings carry a 1-year warranty and galvanised pipes 3 years. See also Thoothukudi.

faq.q: Is grouting better than self-standing on a windy site?
faq.a: Usually, yes. Posts set into concrete footings stay firm when strong winds hit tall structures. We suggest the method for each piece on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Which pieces suit an exposed, windy ground?
faq.a: Lower structures with fewer solid panels, such as climbers, see-saws and compact stations. Tall towers with roofs are better placed behind a building or trees.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Tirunelveli?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road from our Vasai East factory and install it with our own team or a dealer in south India.

intro: New residential layouts and gated villa projects keep coming up around Tirupati, below the Tirumala hills, and most of them promise buyers a children's park. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these developers, and for schools, colleges and parks in Tirupati, at our factory in Vasai East, about 940 km away.

Tirupati is hot and dry for much of the year, with summers that peak in May and rain from both monsoons. Besides the pilgrim trade, the city has several universities and a growing number of schools. Our installation team or a local dealer sets up the equipment once it arrives from Vasai by road. Send us the layout plan with the park plot marked, and we will place equipment and its safe play area on a drawing your architect can use.

sections.h: A central children's park for a villa layout
sections.html:
In a villa layout, the park is often the plot buyers notice first on a site visit. Put it where most houses can see it and away from the main entry road. One themed structure, such as a piece from Castle Crest or Forestia, gives the park a clear centre. Swings and spring riders can sit around it.

Plan the park at the start, so drains, lighting and paths go in around the equipment and not through it. Keep the safe play area clear of lamp posts and lawn sprinklers. Shade matters in Tirupati's summer. For the adult side, see our Tirupati outdoor gym page.

faq.q: Can you plan a children's park for a new layout?
faq.a: Yes. Share the layout plan with the park plot marked. We suggest equipment and send a drawing with the safe play area for each piece, which your architect can add to the plan.

faq.q: Which equipment works as a centrepiece for a park?
faq.a: A themed multi play station from Castle Crest, Forestia or Robo Romp, or a larger NexLev structure. Smaller pieces such as swings and spring riders can then sit around it.

faq.q: Do you install in Tirupati?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment from Vasai East by road, about 940 km, and install it through our own team or a local dealer.

intro: Tiruppur's knitwear exporters care a great deal about colour, and the same people often ask whether a playground for their school, staff colony or family property can match a set palette. It can. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment in more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,030 km from Tiruppur.

Tiruppur lies in the dry western belt of Tamil Nadu, close to Coimbatore, with hot summers and modest rain. Garment units, schools run by business families and new apartment projects all buy play equipment here. Delivery is by road from Vasai, and installation is handled by our team or a south Indian dealer. Send us your colour references with the site size, and we will suggest a colour scheme from our shades along with the layout drawing.

sections.h: Matching playground colours to a brand or building
sections.html:
Start with two or three main colours from your building or logo and use them on the larger parts, such as roofs, slides and panels. Keep one bright accent for handholds and steps so children can see them clearly. Colours that are too close to each other look flat outdoors. Ask us for the nearest match from our shade range.

Darker shades heat up faster in Tiruppur's sun, so use them on panels and keep slide beds lighter. Colour and design customisation is available on request across our Funplay Originals and Play Lands ranges. See also our Coimbatore page.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be made in our company colours?
faq.a: We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades. Send us your colour references and we will suggest the closest match for each part of the structure.

faq.q: Do dark colours get too hot in the sun?
faq.a: They heat up faster than light shades. Use darker colours on panels and roofs, and keep slide beds and seats in lighter shades or in shade.

faq.q: Do you supply Tiruppur?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is made in Vasai East, sent by road and installed by our own team or a dealer in south India, after you approve the layout and quote.

intro: Tiruvottiyur, on the northern seafront of Chennai, mixes older streets, industrial units near the ports and newer apartment blocks. Builders here need a play area that holds up to inspection when the flats are handed over to the residents' association. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for these projects, and for schools and parks, at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,050 km away.

The area comes under the Greater Chennai Corporation and shares the city's hot, humid weather and north-east monsoon from October to December. Sites close to the shore also get salt air. We send equipment by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India. Share the size of the play area and your expected handover month, and we will plan the order around that date.

sections.h: What a builder should hand over with the play area
sections.html:
When a residents' association takes charge of the play area, it needs papers as well as equipment. Keep the approved layout drawing, the list of pieces and the warranty terms in the handover file. Note our after-sales number, +91 738 530 0921, so the association knows whom to call.

The warranty runs for 3 years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and 1 year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is maintained as per our instructions, so pass those instructions on too. Near the sea, the association should rinse the equipment regularly. See our Chennai page for more.

faq.q: Which documents should a builder keep for the play area?
faq.a: The approved layout drawing, the list of equipment, the warranty terms and our maintenance instructions. Hand these over to the residents' association along with our after-sales contact.

faq.q: How should a seafront society look after its playground?
faq.a: Rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time to clear salt, check bolts and seats regularly and follow the maintenance steps we share at handover.

faq.q: Do you install in Tiruvottiyur?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory by road and install through our own team or a dealer in south India.
